cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Two office biscuits are missing. We've got an organised operation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. A confession this quick suggests training.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they're recruiting through hunger. This goes higher than the biscuit tin.

mechanism: A treats a pupil mundane explanation as evidence of a bigger operation and claims it taught the analytical habit needed to see it.
confusable: Not merely repeating suspicion: each small correction expands the alleged system behind the biscuits.
comparison: Conspiracy inference from snacking versus institutional crisis inferred from an unsent email.
seedUse: D24 confession/hunger chain stays, but S05 claims instruction in following clues and grades B too-small conclusions.
